opening.quote: Good afternoon, Tidewell Home, my name is Sanne. How can I help?
opening.comment: You gave your name and the company name in your first turn, which meets the opening standard.

verification.quote: Can I take your full name and your order i number or postcode, please?
verification.comment: You asked for the full name and order number before accessing the order, and the caller provided both.

understanding.quote: So you're asking when the €81.00 will be back on your card?
understanding.comment: You captured the refund question correctly and did not ask for information the caller had already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Refunds are paid within 5 working days of the return arriving, so it will be on your card within 5 working days from yesterday.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The 5-working-day timeline is correct, but you stated the refund amount as €81.00 without explaining the difference from €84.00 and the policy does not cover that figure, so please confirm the amount before quoting it.

process_compliance.quote: Can I put you on hold far a moment while I check the refund is queued?
process_compliance.comment: You asked permission before placing the caller on hold, but you did not thank them when they returned from the hold.

communication.quote: Thank you far waiting. It's queued, and you'll get ans email the day paid.
communication.comment: Your tone was polite and courteous throughout, and the caller was not frustrated.

closing.quote: Is there anything else I can help you with?
closing.comment: You confirmed the next step and asked if there was anything else, then closed politely.
